title_sq: Tek Rruga Siri Kodra, Shitet Apartament 2+1+2 Shume Prane Bulevardit Te Ri!
description_sq: Tek Rruga Siri Kodra, Shitet Apartament 2+1+2 Shume Prane Bulevardit te Ri! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 4 me orientim nga Jugu dhe Perendimi! Prona ka nje planimetri te shfrytezuar maksimalisht dhe shume te rregullt, e perbere nga kuzhina dhe ambient ndenje, 2 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete dhe ballkoni. Apartamenti pritet te perfundoje ne Mars te vitit 2026. Mundesi zgjedhje opsione me siperfaqe te ndryshme. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet apartamenti eshte nder zonat me te kerkuara, mjaft e qete dhe me te gjitha facilitetet per nje jetese komode.
title_en: On Siri Kodra Street, 2+1+2 Apartment for sale, very close to New Boulevard!
description_en: On Siri Kodra Street, 2+1+2 Apartment for sale, very close to New Boulevard! The apartment is located on the 4th floor facing South and West! The property has a maximally used and very neat floor plan, consisting of a kitchen and living room, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony. The apartment is expected to be completed in March 2026. You can choose options with different surfaces. The area in which the apartment is located is one of the most sought-after areas, quite quiet and with all the facilities for a comfortable life.
